Name: Cuter Pig
Author: Alitch
Description:
The current pig is too big and ugly, and the baby pig doesn't look like a baby. Now you can have real baby pigs.
If you like tiny, little, cute pigs, this is your mod.

Installation:
- Copy contents of zip file into Starew Valley/Content/Animals
 
Enjoy the cuteness <3
